annotations.text: The tokens are lifted from src/style.css, not approximated: warm paper stage, ink text, an indigo network and a copper accent for anything that flows. The diverging pair is separate so a flow color is never read as a direction of effect.

One shell in every lens: identity and caption top left, lens switcher top center, comparison of interest and model bottom left, inspector right, readouts bottom center. Switching lens changes the question, never the furniture.

The current animates: a still band carries the width, a dashed band slides along it at a constant speed. Same speed everywhere on purpose, so width alone means how much evidence travels that way. It stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

Narrow windows keep the comparison picker on screen, since every lens depends on it, and move the lens switcher to a strip at the foot where a thumb is. Targets are 44px. The network keeps the top of the screen to itself.
